## DIARRHEA WITH SALMONELLA (NONTYPHOIDAL SALMONELLA)
For systemic febrile illness or typhoidal Salmonella, refer to Enteric Fever
treatment recommendations.
[Enteric Fever treatment recommendations](enteric-fever)
Treatment is not recommended for mild or moderately severe disease
## Primary treatment
Hydration and electrolyte replacement
## Antimicrobial treatment for severe disease
## Inpatient [Ciprofloxacin 500 mg PO q12h for 7 days [R,DI]](psjzid-ciprofloxacin-500mg-po-q12h)
If infection acquired after international travel or patient is intolerant to
fluoroquinolones:
[Azithromycin 500 mg PO q24h for 7 days [M]](psjzid-azithromycin-500mg-po-q24h)
For patients who are hospitalized or unable to take oral medications:
[Ceftriaxone 2 gm IV q24h for 7 days [M]](psjizid-ceftriaxone-2gm-iv-q24h)
